_help: Everything that can be bought. id: short, no spaces. type: book, report, certificate, export (what it is). usd and inr: the price in dollars and rupees (whole rupees). file: for downloads, the file's path inside the private Supabase Storage bucket paid-files (upload it there; leave out for things made on the page). perItem: true when the purchase is for one toy, quiz or tool (for example the full report of one toy); the page sends which one. The payment server reads this file from the live site, so the price here is the price charged. Check every price before going live.
currencyNote: Visitors in India pay in rupees (UPI or card). Everyone else pays in US dollars (card).
